title: Ukrainian-Style Pork Kebabs
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring marinated pork kebabs, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, onion, garlic, and allspice.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove pork from marinade, allowing excess to drip off.
Thread pork onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill for 8-10 minutes per side, or until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
